title: A stack generation change is not 'update two SHAs': old and new LibRPA lines are not even ancestors
symptom: Swapping the pinned LibRPA SHA from an old profile onto a new source tree makes old benchmarks meaningless; remote binaries from June silently test the old chain.
root_cause: The legacy profile (ABACUS 3efad9e / LibRPA dd169fa) and the new sources are different generations not on one ancestor chain; benchmark references do not transfer across generations.
minimal_fix: Declare a new profile generation (new profile id, fresh frozen references, fresh regression bundle); keep old generations readable for forensics only.
validation: Benchmark replay must run against the profile it was frozen with; cross-generation comparisons are reported as BLOCKED, never as failures.
avoid: Patching SHAs in place; mixing frozen references from one generation with binaries of another.

parameters.rule: new profile id + fresh frozen references per stack generation
